name: Depth Charge V
text:
Ammunition any

---

Carved with stylized images of water or aquatic life, depth charges that are fired underwater or at a submerged target function with their normal range increments and can hit no matter their normal damage type. This ammunition explodes if it hits a target underwater, dealing 11d6 bludgeoning damage in a 20-foot burst DC 32 basic Fortitude save according to its type. This burst doesn't extend out of the water.
